records.quote: We must accept finite disappointment, but we must never lose infinite hope.
records.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

records.quote: Use what you’ve been through as fuel, believe in yourself and be unstoppable!
records.author: Yvonne Pierre

records.quote: To succeed, you have to do something and be very bad at it for a while. You have to look bad before you can look really good.
records.author: Barbara DeAngelis

records.quote: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
records.author: Alan Kay

records.quote: Testing shows the presence, not the absence of bugs.
records.author: Edsger W. Dijkstra

records.quote: Talk is cheap. Show me the code.
records.author: Linus Torvalds

records.quote: Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.
records.author: Harold Abelson
